title: 在训狗中学到的控制权与人性(5)
desc: 在训狗中学到的控制权与人性(5)

paragraphs.en: "Positively reinforcing" desirable behaviour is hard.
paragraphs.zh: 对理想行为做“正向强化”并不轻松。

paragraphs.en: It is time-consuming and extremely repetitive – more like going to the gym than teaching students, and I know which one I find more fulfilling.
paragraphs.zh: 耗时漫长，极度重复，比起教书更像去健身房，而我清楚哪一件事更有成就感。

paragraphs.en: But if your food treats are (in the jargon) "high value" enough, and you put in the hours, it does work.
paragraphs.zh: 但只要零食（业内叫“高价值奖励”）足够有吸引力，投入足够多时间，这套方法确实有效。

paragraphs.en: Dusty now comes back to us when called, most of the time.
paragraphs.zh: 现在喊达斯蒂回来，大多数时候它都会回到我们身边。

paragraphs.en: She's still a very excitable dog, but I'm now able to avoid situations like the one in the park that fateful day.
paragraphs.zh: 它依旧是一只极易兴奋的狗，但我已经能够避开公园那天那样的窘境。

paragraphs.en: Getting to this point requires grasping an additional key difference between dogs and humans: the absence of a moral psyche also means an inability to generalise from one situation to another.
paragraphs.zh: 走到这一步，还需要理解狗与人另一处关键差异：没有道德心理，意味着它们无法把一个场景学到的经验，推广到别的场景。

paragraphs.en: Dogs can become controllable and predictable in one context, and then behave entirely differently in another.
paragraphs.zh: 狗狗可以在一种环境里变得可控、可预判，换个环境，行为就全然不同。

paragraphs.en: And while it is possible to control the environment in your kitchen, you can never be sure what novelty might suddenly appear in the park.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以控制自家厨房的环境，却永远无法预料公园里会突然冒出什么新鲜事物。

paragraphs.en: The Steve Mann answer to this problem is simple: don't put your dog in situations that you can't control or which have provoked bad behaviours in the past.
paragraphs.zh: 史蒂夫·曼给出的解决方案很简单：不要把狗放到你无法掌控，或是过往会触发不良行为的场景里。

paragraphs.en: This ultimately is how most dog owners cope, not training their dog to behave well in every situation, but striving to avoid those situations when they know they won't.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数养狗人最终都是这么应对的，不是训练狗狗在所有场合乖乖听话，而是一旦预判局面失控，就尽量避开。

paragraphs.en: But as much as we seek to leap wholesale into a world in which control is perfected through manipulating rewards, environmental cues and neural pathways, my experience with Dusty suggests that what humans are really looking for in all of this is an escape from their own guilt.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管我们一心想进入一个依靠奖励、环境信号、神经通路完美实现控制的世界，但和达斯蒂相处的经历告诉我，人类在这一切当中真正想要的，是摆脱自身的愧疚。

paragraphs.en: Many dog owners never have to pick up a training manual because their dogs are so placid (or small) that they never feel the need.
paragraphs.zh: 很多主人从来不用翻看训犬手册，因为他们的狗性格温顺（或是体型很小），完全没有这个必要。

paragraphs.en: But others never do so because the anger of other people doesn't bother them very much.
paragraphs.zh: 也有一些主人不看，是因为别人的指责很难影响到他们。

paragraphs.en: The exit from morality into a world of "positive reinforcement" and brain chemistry is only ever partial, for the simple reason that none of us ever achieves perfect control.
paragraphs.zh: 从道德评判转向“正向强化”与脑神经的世界，永远只能是有限的转变，理由很简单：没有人能实现绝对的掌控。

paragraphs.en: Learning not to judge and punish your own dog is relatively easy to do.
paragraphs.zh: 学着不去评判、惩罚自家的狗，相对容易做到。

paragraphs.en: I've learned the hard way that the difference between a frustrating walk and an emotionally disastrous one is about something else altogether: whether or not other dog owners judge me.
paragraphs.zh: 我惨痛地意识到，一场让人沮丧的遛狗和一场情绪崩溃的遛狗，根本区别不在于狗狗，而在于别的养狗人会不会评判我。

paragraphs.en: What we most crave, once control is in the balance, is not scientific facts or diagnosis, but kindness and understanding – things that only another human being can provide.
paragraphs.zh: 当掌控感岌岌可危时，我们最渴求的不是科学结论或是诊断，而是善意与理解——这些只有同类才能给予。

paragraphs.en: In Dusty's early days, when we felt quite lost, I used to occasionally encounter a friendly bedraggled stranger, who would always comment on what a lovely dog I had, which meant a surprising amount to me.
paragraphs.zh: 达斯蒂小时候，我们手足无措的时候，偶尔会碰到一位看起来邋遢友善的陌生人，总会夸我的狗很好看，这句话对我意义重大。

paragraphs.en: On about the seventh occasion I saw him, he was sitting in a churchyard smoking crack.
paragraphs.zh: 大概第七次见到他时，他正坐在教堂墓园里吸食可卡因。

paragraphs.en: Dogs transcend social boundaries better even than sport and childcare, those usual mainstays of community expansion in secular societies.
paragraphs.zh: 狗甚至比运动和育儿更能打破社会边界，而运动和育儿本是世俗社会维系社群的常见纽带。

paragraphs.en: Since then, we've become accepted into various loose, overlapping communities of local dog owners, who offer what can best be described as solidarity.
paragraphs.zh: 从那以后，我们融入了当地松散交错的养狗人群体，大家给予彼此的，可以说是一种共情互助。

paragraphs.en: Sometimes you just need another person to tell you that they've been there, and you're doing OK.
paragraphs.zh: 有时你只需要另一个养狗人告诉你，他也经历过这些，你已经做得很好了。

paragraphs.en: As for Dusty, she remains as beautiful and blameless as ever.
paragraphs.zh: 至于达斯蒂，她依旧漂亮，也从来没有过错。
